# Title
Saudi Gold Rates (saudigoldrates.com) - Live Gold Prices & FinTech Tools

# Description
Saudi Gold Rates is an independent financial technology platform operated by Abraaj Growth Labs. It provides real-time, API-driven gold prices in Saudi Arabia (SAR) based on the Global Spot Market. The platform integrates ZATCA (Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority) tax rules for precise consumer pricing, bullion investments, scrap gold valuation, and an automated Zakat calculator.
